ti.title: ምሉእ ደስታ ጌረ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]

[[/chorus]]

ምሉእ ደስታ ጌረ ክቖጽሮ
ሓላፊ መከራይ ክስዕሮ
ሓይሊ ብዝህበኒ ብጐይታ
ንልበይ ከበርትዖ ኮታ (2)

ምስ ደርበየኒ ዝፋን ዓለም
ጐይታ መንኮብካ ንዓይ ይስከም
ኣየማርርን ብዝኾነ
ስራሕካ ስለዘይቀነነ

ብጸባብ ደገ ዝሰጎሙ
ንጊዚኡ’ኳ ተተጸገሙ
ፈለማ ተበዝሐ ስቓይ
ፍጻሜ ሓጎስ’ዩ ኣብ ሰማይ

ሰረገላ እሳት ዝቕመጥ
ንዓለም ብኢዱ ዝጭብጥ
ስቓይ ተጸመመ ብፍቕሪ
ከይበለ ተመንጢለ ክብሪ

ዘማሪ ዳግማዊ ደርቤ

ti_ro.title: Mlu' desta gere
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Nlbey keberto kota (2)
[[/chorus]]

Mlu desta gere kqotsro
Halafi mekeray ksro
Hayli bzhbeni bgoyta

Ms derbeyeni zfan alem
Goyta menkobka nay yskem
Ayemarrn bzkhone
Srahka slezeyqenene
Nay hazen aykonen nbatey
Bertiuni mber hagosey
Msakha berekha lemlem’yu
Mnbar’wn nbeynu khul’yu

Btsebab dege zsegomu
Ngiziu’kwa tetetsegemu
Felema tebezha sqay
Ftsame hagos’yu ab semay
Wengel mtswa’yu mflay
Kab hasot nhaqi mhray
Kab bet frdi mwtsa bhagos
Nabekha nsm krstos

Seregela sat zqmet
Nalem bidu zchbt
Sqay tetsememe bfqri
Keybele tementile kbri
Bkhemzi motey kab ahlefo
Kemzi koyne ile aygedfo
Ab lli mabel zsma
Ftwey’yu nay ztsawa
